venue_displayed.what: gdex.pro HyperLiquid PnL leaderboard row, 'week' window PnL (includes unrealized mark-to-market + funding).
venue_displayed.payload_origin: saved payload gdex_hl_top_traders_by_pnl_2026-10-15.json (the gdex MCP tool response, @gemachdao/gdex-mcp-server: get_hl_top_traders_by_pnl)
venue_displayed.access_note: Keyless GET; the endpoint answers HTTP 403 'Non-browser clients not allowed' unless the gdex SDK's default browser User-Agent is sent, which is what the gdex MCP server itself sends.

chain_fills.what: Realized closed PnL (closedPnl - fee) per fill for every address in the actor grouping over the trailing-7d window [start,end] ending at the board observation.

why_not_gdex.what: gdex read tools probed for a per-fill history of a third-party wallet (the chain side). None served one; the chain side therefore comes from the L1 info API and is labeled so.
code 101 'missing params' for a leaderboard address (the endpoint lists a gdex copy-trade user's own transactions, not an arbitrary wallet's).
why_not_gdex.get_wallet_performance (GET /v1/wallet_p: code 101 'missing params' with and without a chain argument.
why_not_gdex.get_hl_user_stats (GET /v1/hl/user_stats: code 103 'Wallet not found' for leaderboard addresses (gdex-managed wallets only).
why_not_gdex.get_hl_trade_history: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND '@gdexsdk/hyper-liquid-trader' in the installed MCP server; and by its source it calls HyperLiquid userFills directly, not a gdex endpoint.

actor_grouping.rule: address->actor grouping is an INPUT to the pure adapter, not computed by it; a fill outside the grouping raises AdapterError.
actor_grouping.clustering_finding: wallet-independence clustering is not applicable to a single address and was not run; see the _gdex_multi capture for the multi-address case and its clustering finding.

dispute_semantics.meaning: A dispute fires when the displayed window bucket differs from the bucket of realized-closed PnL over the same window for the declared actor grouping. It records that the displayed figure is not reproducible from the actor's closed fills (the copier's verification gap) - NOT that any single number was falsified.

selection.how: Every distinct address on gdex's four PnL boards (day/week/month/allTime, 30 rows each) in the pinned payload was scanned: realized-closed net over the trailing-7d window vs the row's displayed 'week' bucket; the HL sub-account registry was read for each. One fully-covered (uncapped) divergence was selected per capture.
selection.aggregate_finding: The displayed week figure is not reproducible from the same address's closed fills for 43 of 84 board rows; 24 rows display a nonzero week PnL with zero closed fills (unrealized mark-to-market only). The verification gap is the norm on this board, not a contrived case.
